b1_group_ranker.head: Linear(64, 32) -> ReLU -> Linear(32, 1), matching the frozen SPECK B1 head

seed_governance.key_policy: one_master_key_per_group; check uniqueness within each split and exact train-validation key intersection before training
seed_governance.isolation_guarantee: Different PRNG seeds alone do not prove disjoint master keys. Abort before training if train_keys intersect validation_keys, or if either generated key set contains duplicates. Keep development and unseen attack keys ungenerated until their separate protocol gates; subsequently audit their exact key intersections without using outcomes for selection.

dataset_specifications.b0_source: generate_simon_b0_pairs: 1,000,000 independent-key training pairs at seed 880001 and 100,000 independent-key validation pairs at seed 880002; use the same direct-pair positive and random-plaintext negative policies as B1
dataset_specifications.b1_source: generate_simon_b1_groups: one sampled master key per 64-pair group, with exact key uniqueness/intersection audit before any optimizer step
dataset_specifications.positive_pair_policy: P0 uniform random, P1 = P0 ^ (0x0000, 0x0040), both encrypted under group master key
dataset_specifications.negative_pair_policy: P0 uniform random, P1 independent uniform random, both encrypted under group master key
dataset_specifications.group_consistency: All 64 pairs in a B1 group share the exact same master-key role

training_hyperparameters.checkpoint_selection: For B0 and B1 separately, save the epoch with minimum validation BCE; exact ties choose the earlier epoch. Use patience 3 and at most 10 epochs. Do not select by attack-key ranks, recovery, or validation accuracy threshold.

outcome_independent_stop_and_promotion_r.primary_mandate: Retain and report a trained runnable B1 model even if distinguishing accuracy is weak (e.g., 50.8%), labeling it descriptive; fail ONLY for genuine engineering defects
engineering_defect_criteria: Loss or model weights become NaN or infinite
Gradient vanishing across entire architecture (all param.grad == 0)
Unhandled runtime exception, CUDA OOM, or memory leak
outcome_independent_stop_and_promotion_r.negative_result_preservation: Finite flat loss and weak distinguishing accuracy are reportable results, not grounds to exclude a runnable model. Preserve the selected checkpoint and evaluate it in the descriptive B1 attack arm without searching for favorable seeds or architectures.
ranking_eligibility_criteria: Model outputs finite, deterministic real scores on candidate-inverted inputs
Weights and biases contain zero NaN or Inf entries
Inference on 65,536 candidates completes within local resource allowance
